# Service desk ticket INC1004

**From:** Head of SRE

Last night's disk-full page for orders-db went unanswered for three hours. Find out why, fix it so that tonight's pages reach someone, and close out the incident.

## Tools

Call `search_operations` to discover the API operations available in each system, then use them to investigate and act.

checks.desc: No override puts Dev (on leave) on call this week.
Dev covers Kiran's vacation next week with an override.
The ticket records the override as the root cause.

The Web team's weekend swap is kept.
No new overrides on the Web schedule.
Kiran is not put on call during his own vacation.

output.final_message: Root cause: override OVR-1 on the orders-db schedule (SCH-DB) routed pages to Dev Malik for 19–26 Oct, but Dev was on leave 19–25 Oct (HR) and Kiran Rao was the rostered on-call. I deleted OVR-1, so tonight's pages follow the regular rotation to Kiran, and verified that no overrides remain. I added investigation notes to PI-77 and INC1004 and closed INC1004. Open follow-ups, not fixed here: WAL archive retention (disk was cleared to 61%, not fixed at source), the roughly 3-hour delay before escalation to level 2, and the lack of a leave check when overrides are created.
